entries.headline: Weekly flu toll of 219 severe cases and 44 deaths dominates coverage
entries.why: Multiple outlets report a weekly peak, framed as a five-year high by some and 'highest since last season' by others. Severity is now the main frame driving urgency, with doctors targeting older and chronically ill people.

entries.headline: Public flu uptake hits 1.91 million in eight days; official voices supply worry
entries.why: Lo Yi-chun publicly worried that supply may not be enough after 1.32 million doses in six days, a rare on-record signal of allocation pressure. Expect stakeholder questions on stock and stage-two readiness.

entries.headline: Taiwan CDC reports strong uptake, urges eligible people to vaccinate before holidays
entries.zh: 公費流感及新冠疫苗接種踴躍 請符合資格民眾儘速接種 及早獲得保護力
entries.why: This is the agency's latest position: it links ongoing severe cases to an early-vaccination push. It sets the official tone that local bureaus in Kaohsiung, Keelung and Hsinchu are echoing.

entries.headline: Users report self-pay flu stock gaps and single-brand clinics; Kaohsiung queues reported
entries.why: Posts say Kaohsiung clinics told callers self-pay vaccine arrives only in November and that public clinics stock one brand. News separately reports hospital queues after 35 Kaohsiung deaths, so access friction is becoming a local story.

entries.headline: Enhanced and adjuvanted vaccine claims circulate via doctors, media and a clinic post
entries.why: Doctors urge older adults toward the enhanced vaccine, and a clinic post (131 engagements) makes comparative efficacy and duration claims for an adjuvanted product. That raises advertising-compliance and reputational exposure for the category.

entries.headline: Parents confused by child two-dose rule; fever posts after nasal and injected shots
entries.why: A reported dosing change for 6-month to 3-year-olds is producing conflicting clinic answers. Parent posts about fever after vaccination are drawing engagement, a likely pediatric hesitancy pocket.

watch.text: Second stage of the publicly funded flu programme opens. Watch whether early supply concerns lead to allocation changes or messaging on stock.
150,000 Novavax COVID doses are reported to start as part of the joint 'left flu, right COVID' campaign, which may refresh dual-shot safety questions.
Posts say Kaohsiung clinics expect self-pay flu stock only then. One outlet also says flu will not ease until November. Track access complaints and severity reporting.

policy_notes.why: Sets the 2026 programme baseline: phase 1 for 11 groups from October 1 with about 6.449 million standard and 170,000 enhanced doses plus health-coin incentives.
Launch event confirmed 7.05 million flu doses procured including enhanced vaccine, the figure now used to judge supply adequacy.
CDC links ongoing severe flu activity to unvaccinated older adults and urges pre-holiday vaccination, framing the current severity narrative.

products.name: Beyfortus
products.signal: No nirsevimab-specific coverage or official notice this week. RSV conversation is thin but new: one low-engagement post on a European maternal RSV vaccination study, plus storylines grouping RSV with COPD and asthma recommendations.
products.implication: Infant RSV prevention is entering public discussion through the maternal vaccination frame first, so the infant-antibody option may be discussed by comparison before it is discussed on its own terms.
products.action: Prepare a neutral evidence and policy briefing on infant RSV prevention approaches for paediatric and obstetric stakeholders, and set up monitoring for parent questions as the RSV conversation develops. Do not engage in public comparison.

products.name: High-dose influenza vaccine
products.signal: No high-dose-specific items this week. The enhanced category (type not stated) remains active: the CDC prioritises enhanced vaccine for long-term care facilities, doctors urge older adults to get enhanced vaccine amid record severity, and a media item and a clinic post (flagged misleading) circulate percentage efficacy claims.
products.implication: Older-adult severity and supply worries keep enhanced vaccines in the news, but public framing is driven by loose efficacy percentages and clinic promotion, which invites regulatory and reputational scrutiny across the category.
products.action: Brief geriatric and long-term care stakeholders with balanced, referenced evidence on enhanced-vaccine categories. Prepare holding lines on supply and allocation questions ahead of the second stage, and avoid any association with clinic-level comparative claims.
who: Taiwan CDC and local health bureaus

products.name: Tdap booster
products.signal: Little this week: no Tdap news items or official notices. Tdap appears only in a few storylines on vaccine recommendations for chronic lung disease, COPD and asthma patients.
products.implication: Pertussis is not a public issue right now; the only entry point is the respiratory-risk framing aimed at chronic lung patients.
products.action: Map chest and respiratory physician stakeholders, and keep an adult booster evidence summary ready in case respiratory-risk coverage broadens beyond flu and COVID.
who: Patient groups for COPD and asthma

issues.title: Supply adequacy as the second public-programme stage opens
issues.note: An official has voiced concern about supply after rapid uptake, and users report self-pay doses unavailable until November. Expect questions on allocation, including enhanced vaccines for older adults.

issues.title: Comparative efficacy claims for enhanced and adjuvanted vaccines
issues.note: A clinic post with misleading adjuvanted-vaccine claims drew notable engagement, and media repeat a 25% enhanced-vaccine figure. Manufacturers should be ready to distance themselves from promotional claims.

issues.title: Safety narrative from side-effect posts and injury relief coverage
issues.note: Side-effect logs and child-fever posts draw high engagement, a vaccine injury relief award was reported, and opposed posts question dual-shot safety. Prepare factual reference material for HCP and agency partners.
